critical_code_review_comments: auth.py MODULE_ACCESS.reports uses _FINANCE which excludes 'data_entry'/'operations' — intentional but confirm PRD; operations demo role currently lacks reports/expenses (they map to data_entry tier which has expenses but not reports).

Frontend Layout.jsx filters by NAV_MODULE while roleTier() still injects ADMIN_GROUP/ADMINISTRATION items before module filter — works because 'users'/'test-data'/'org-settings' are gated in modules, but the two-layer gating (tier + modules) is coupled; refactor to single source of truth (modules array) to avoid divergence.

GlobalSearch visibility check uses `!user?.modules || user.modules.includes('search')` — the truthy-fallback (`!user?.modules`) means if backend ever omits modules, drivers would see search again. Recommend hard-fail: `user?.modules?.includes('search')`.

/api/vehicles intentionally open to drivers for form dropdowns but this leaks the entire fleet list. Consider a dedicated /api/vehicles/mine or /api/vehicles/lookup for drivers returning only assigned vehicle.
